Bug report

Title: Checkout total is wrong when a promo code and a gift card are both applied

Description: If you apply a 10% promo code first and then a $50 gift card, the total comes out as the full price minus $50. The promo is ignored. But if you apply the gift card first and the promo second, it works. So the order matters, and it shouldn't.

Steps to reproduce: Add any item over $100 to the cart, apply the promo code SAVE10, then apply a $50 gift card.

Expected: The promo is applied to the subtotal and then the gift card is subtracted.
Actual: The promo is dropped.

I suspect the gift card handler overwrites the discount field, but...
